Tlv branch
We just left Tlv branch for the 1st meeting as they schedule us 2x always. This is the documents check… 

The interview is this Thursday and the clerk today extended my visa for 3 months “as a precaution”, I have a5, this is the second renewal and we paid 250 NIs? She told us that we won’t need to pay for the next sticker with the proper year time. 

Also she told me that they don’t give 2 years visa and “if we don’t like we should move cities”
